issuing_body: 과학기술정보통신부 (Ministry of Science and ICT, Republic of Korea) / 한국지능정보사회진흥원 (NIA)
compliance_deadlines: 2026년 1월 인공지능 기본법 시행 (AI Basic Act enters into force January 2026)
implementation_notes: The guideline explicitly states it has no legal binding force ('가이드라인 자체는 법적 구속력은 없으나 법상 의무 이행을 지원하기 위한 목적으로 제작') but supports compliance with the legally binding obligations of Article 34 of the AI Basic Act (인공지능 기본법). Obligations under Article 34 include: (1) risk management plan establishment and operation; (2) explainability plan for AI outputs, key criteria, and training data; (3) user protection plan; (4) human oversight of high-impact AI; (5) documentation and retention of safety/reliability measures. High-impact AI domains are enumerated in the AI Basic Act and include energy supply, water treatment, healthcare, medical devices, nuclear facility management, biometric data for criminal investigation, hiring and loan review, transportation, public services decision-making, and student assessment in early/primary/secondary education.
